sourceRule: RadioGroup uses a generic value/defaultValue and onValueChange(value,eventDetails), plus disabled/readOnly/required/name/form. RadioGroupItem inherits the exact Radio.Root props including value and disabled. The default visible root is span role=radio with a hidden native radio input, not a visible native radio. Checked value is singular; choosing the checked item does not clear the group. Disabled/readOnly suppress user changes; callback cancellation can veto and controlled props stay authoritative.
keyboardAndFocus: Tab enters the current/enabled radio; arrows navigate/select enabled items using the source composite and wrap behavior. Space selects a radio. Enter does not toggle (the source prevents its button activation; form context remains separate). Home/End are disabled by the RadioGroup composite; Escape does not clear selection.
referenceComposition: Delivery plan
protocol: SCXML consumes actual source callback transactions and source focus observations after native pointer/keyboard normalization, preserving original eventDetails. Sends document observed React callbacks, never duplicate DOM dispatches. Canceled user requests preserve value; controlled SET_VALUE does not emit a change. Tabs automatic consistency updates are separate and uncancelable. Source owns quantization, collision, focus wrapping and native form integration.
